issues.description: `isIncluded` complects three concerns into one mutated cache and a boolean
issues.detail: What used to be a pattern-match predicate now also encodes 'is this file in the changed set' and is gated by a clear-the-cache call from `onTestRunStart`. Inclusion-by-glob, changed-set membership, and cache lifecycle are three separable concerns braided into one method. Decompose: pure `matchesGlob(file)`, pure `inChangedSet(file)`, compose at the call site; the cache becomes one concern, not three.

issues.description: `changedFiles` is place-oriented state on the provider with implicit time semantics
issues.detail: `this.changedFiles` is a mutable field set inside `onTestRunStart` and read by `isIncluded` and `getUntestedFiles`. The 'value at time of run start' and 'identity of the provider' are now the same variable, and any caller invoking `isIncluded` before `onTestRunStart` silently gets the pre-changed answer. Make the changed set an explicit value passed into a run context, or at least an immutable snapshot keyed by run id.

issues.description: `onTestRunStart` is wired in three call sites with no shared invariant
issues.detail: Three separate places in `core.ts` now must remember to call `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` immediately after `_testRun.start`. The invariant 'every test run start notifies the coverage provider' lives in the heads of future maintainers, not in the code. A single `startTestRun` helper that owns both calls would make the time semantics explicit and remove the easy-to-miss fourth case.

issues.description: CLI `transform` accepts boolean inputs that argument parsing cannot produce
issues.detail: The `transform(value)` checks for `value === true` and `value === false` alongside the string forms. CLI argument values arrive as strings; the boolean branches are dead unless something upstream is already coercing, which would itself be the bug. Either delete the boolean branches or name where non-string values come from. Right now the function pretends to handle a shape it never sees.

issues.description: Inheritance from `test.changed` is silent and irreversible from CLI
issues.detail: `resolved.coverage.changed === undefined` triggers inheritance from `resolved.changed`. A user who passed `--changed main` and does not want coverage filtered cannot express 'no, do not inherit' except by explicitly setting `coverage.changed: false` in config. The two knobs are coupled by a default rule that is invisible at the call site; consider requiring an explicit opt-in or logging the inheritance.

issues.description: `cleanUrl` slipped into `isIncluded` without a stated reason
issues.detail: The filename normalization changed from `slash(_filename)` to `slash(cleanUrl(_filename))`. This is a real semantic change — query params and hashes are now stripped before matching — but the diff bundles it with the changed-files feature with no comment, no test naming the case, and no note in the description. Either land it as its own commit with a regression test, or document why this feature required it.

review.summary: The feature is useful and the tests demonstrate the happy paths, but the implementation reaches for the easy seams rather than the simple ones. `isIncluded` now complects glob matching, changed-set membership, and cache lifecycle into one method backed by mutable provider state that must be primed by a new lifecycle hook wired into three call sites — an invariant maintained by convention rather than by the code. A `cleanUrl` semantic change is bundled in silently, and the CLI transform handles input shapes it cannot receive. Decompose the predicate, make the changed set an explicit value scoped to a run, and split the URL-normalization change into its own commit with a named test.
